explication: Enchanted is a SwiftUI chat app for using privately hosted Ollama models across Apple platforms. The main workflow is composing a prompt, optionally with an image or voice input, sending conversation context to Ollama, then displaying and saving the response. It also supports model selection, conversation history, read-aloud, settings, and a macOS Spotlight-style prompt/completion panel. The tree and README establish these capabilities; sampled source confirms chat generation and SwiftData persistence, while some UI and store wiring is unsampled.
